# ISKCON Juhu Self-Excellence LMS

> Authentic Vedic wisdom, Self-Excellence courses, Sunday youth classes, sacred pilgrimage journeys, and spiritual books from ISKCON Juhu, Mumbai.

Canonical Website: https://iskconselfexcellence.online
Sitemap: https://iskconselfexcellence.online/sitemap.xml

## Key Offerings & Hubs
- [Home Page](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/): Vedic spiritual learning platform, Sunday classes, and life transformation.
- [Self-Excellence Courses](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/courses): Structured foundational and advanced spiritual courses.
- [Sunday Youth Classes](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/classes): Weekly interactive youth sessions at ISKCON Juhu.
- [Sacred Pilgrimages](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/trips): Guided spiritual journeys to Vrindavan, Mayapur, Jagannath Puri, and holy Dhamas.
- [Spiritual Books](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/books): Authentic Vedic literature by Srila Prabhupada and senior devotees.
- [Spiritual Blogs](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/blogs): Articles on fearlessness, mindfulness, overcoming anxiety, and bhakti-yoga.
- [Video Lectures](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/video-blogs): Practical life guidance and scripture discourses.

## Active Courses
- [Bhagavad-gita Foundations](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/courses/bhagavad-gita-foundations): The Gita in eighteen sessions, read as a practical manual rather than a historical text.
- [Srimad-Bhagavatam Study Circle](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/courses/srimad-bhagavatam-study-circle): A slow, careful reading of the First Canto with discussion each week.
- [The Guru-Disciple Relationship](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/courses/the-guru-disciple-relationship): What guidance means in practice, and how the tradition understands it.
- [Japa and Daily Sadhana](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/courses/japa-and-daily-sadhana): Building a chanting practice that survives a working week.
- [Self-Excellence for Students](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/courses/self-excellence-for-students): Study habits, focus and character, drawn from Vedic principles.
- [Vaishnava Etiquette and Culture](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/courses/vaishnava-etiquette-and-culture): How devotees relate to one another, and why it matters.
- [Brahmacharya Classes](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/courses/brahmacharya-classes): A foundational youth course on fearlessness, overcoming material desires, and spiritual discipline in Brahmacharya by HG Adbhuta Hari Prabhu.
- [Bhagavad Gita](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/courses/bhagavad-gita): A transformative Thursday study series on the verses and philosophy of Srimad Bhagavad Gita by HG Adbhuta Hari Prabhuji.
- [How To Improve Your Japa?](https://iskconselfexcellence.online/courses/how-to-improve-your-japa): Practical techniques and spiritual focus to overcome distractions and deepen your daily chanting meditation by HG Hayagriva Charan Das.
